jobs.description:
CTEK is a global market leader in vehicle charging solutions.
Established in Dalarna Sweden, CTEK is the leading global brand in battery charging solutions, most specifically vehicle charging. CTEK offers products ranging from 12V & 24V battery chargers to charging solutions for electrical vehicles. Products are sold via a carefully selected network of global distributors and retailers, as original equipment, supplied to more than 50 of the world’s leading vehicle manufacturers and through charge point operators, property owners as well as other organizations and individuals providing EV charging infrastructure. CTEK takes pride in its unique culture based on a passion for innovation and a deep commitment to supporting the transition to greener mobility, by adhering to industry leading ESG standards.
Are you an experienced engineering leader who enjoys combining people leadership with technical depth? We are looking for a Development Manager – System and Product Development to join CTEK and help us further develop our products, our people and the way we work. 
Location: Falun/Norrköping, hybrid.  

What you do
As Development Manager, you lead and develop our System Engineers and Technical Product Owners, combining people leadership with technical understanding. A key part of your role is creating clarity around requirements, product scope and priorities, while bringing different functions together around complex technical topics.
You also:

Support and oversee development initiatives and projects driven by our Technical Product Owners

Identify and manage technical risks, dependencies and uncertainties

Drive improvements in systems engineering, requirements management and technical product ownership

Plan and allocate resources across product lines and projects

Take responsibility for key aspects of people management, including budget, competence development, work environment and team structure

Represent your team as part of the wider CTEK organization and understand how your area contributes to the business

Lead in line with our Cornerstones, Innovation, Passion and Trust, encouraging new ideas, creating engagement and building trust through collaboration and accountability.

You report to our CTO.

Your skills
We believe you are an experienced engineering leader with a strong background in product development. You are comfortable working with both people and complex technical topics and have the ability to create structure and clarity when different functions and perspectives need to come together.
You enjoy developing people and ways of working, while staying close enough to the technology to understand challenges, ask the right questions and support good technical decisions.
We also believe you have:

A Master's degree in Engineering or another relevant technical field

Extensive experience from product development organizations, combined with a strong technical background

Leadership experience within systems engineering, architecture or product development

A strong background in systems engineering and integrated hardware/software product development

Experience from hardware-centric product development is preferred

Experience from the full product development lifecycle, from concept to production and maintenance

Strong communication skills and the ability to bring people together around complex technical topics

A pragmatic and solution-oriented mindset

Good business understanding and the ability to connect technical decisions with business needs

Fluent English, both written and spoken.

Application Apply no later than 15 November 2026.

Other We have chosen our recruitment channels for this process and kindly ask recruitment agencies and other third-party providers to refrain from contacting us regarding this position.
As an applicant, we can offer relocation support through Rekryteringslots. Read more at: https://rekryteringslots.se/medflyttarservice/.

jobs.occupation: Senior C++, Linux Software Engineer  Sensor Control & Radar Systems
jobs.description:
🚀 We’re Hiring: Senior C++ Software Engineer – Sensor Control & Radar Systems
Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB is looking for an experienced Software Engineer for a challenging consulting assignment with an internationally renowned client in the advanced technology and defense industry in Gothenburg, Sweden.
Are you passionate about modern C++ development, Linux-based software systems, and advanced sensor technologies? This is an exciting opportunity to develop core software for sophisticated radar platforms, contributing to products across the entire software lifecycle—from concept and design to deployment, maintenance, and continuous improvement.
We’re looking for a hands-on engineer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, takes ownership of deliverables, and thrives in a collaborative environment with a high degree of responsibility and autonomy.
📍 Location: Gothenburg, Sweden
🎯 Seniority: Senior / Professional Level 4
💻 Core technologies: C++, Linux, Agile, CI/CD
🔐 Security: Successful security clearance required
🎯 About the Role
As a Senior Software Engineer within the Sensor Control Software team, you will develop and maintain core software components for advanced radar and sensor systems.
You will contribute throughout the software development lifecycle, working on current and future sensor platforms. Your responsibilities will include software design, implementation, testing, integration, and maintenance, with a focus on delivering reliable, high-quality software for technically complex applications.
🔧 Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain core software components using modern C++.
Contribute to software development for advanced radar and sensor platforms.
Work across the full product lifecycle, from concept and development to deployment and maintenance.
Develop and troubleshoot software in Linux-based development environments.
Implement and maintain automated tests to ensure software quality and reliability.
Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and architectural decisions.
Work with version control, CI/CD pipelines, and automated development workflows.
Apply agile software development practices to deliver incremental improvements.
Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to solve complex technical problems.
Take ownership of assigned components and drive issues through to resolution.

✅ Required Skills & Qualifications
Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or equivalent relevant experience.
At least 5 years of professional software development experience.
Strong hands-on programming skills in C++.
Experience working in Linux-based development environments.
Solid understanding of software engineering principles and modern development practices.
Experience with version control systems, automated testing, and CI/CD.
Good knowledge of agile software development methodologies.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently, take technical ownership, and collaborate effectively within a team.
Fluent in both Swedish and English, written and spoken.

⭐ Additional Strengths
Experience developing software for radar, sensors, signal processing, or other complex embedded systems.
Familiarity with real-time or performance-critical software.
Experience with continuous integration, automated verification, and software quality assurance.
Strong understanding of collaborative development workflows and engineering best practices.

👤 Our Ideal Candidate
You are a technically strong software engineer who enjoys understanding complex systems and solving challenging engineering problems.
You write clean, maintainable code, take responsibility for the quality of your work, and collaborate effectively with other specialists. You are comfortable working autonomously while contributing to shared engineering goals and continuous improvement.
🔐 Important: Security Clearance
This assignment involves working with classified information. Successful completion of the required security clearance process is mandatory before taking up the assignment. Eligibility will be assessed according to the applicable security requirements.
📩 Interested in This Opportunity?
If you have strong C++ development experience, Linux expertise, and a passion for advanced sensor software, we’d like to hear from you.
Please submit your updated CV highlighting your C++ experience, Linux development, automated testing, and CI/CD expertise. Include your availability and earliest possible start date.
👉 Explore the opportunity and apply:
https://www.hykmann.com/careers

jobs.occupation: We are looking for a Senior Project Manager – Product Performance!
jobs.description:
Are you a driving force within performance improvement and product profitability looking to step into a high-impact transformation role? On behalf of our global industrial client, Academic Work is looking for a Senior Project Manager to lead the realization phase of a major cross-functional profitability project. Here, you will take full ownership of moving strategic analyses into real bottom-line implementation across the entire value chain. Apply today as selection is ongoing!
About the role
Our client is a well-established global industrial organization currently executing a BU-wide strategy to drive sustainable profitability and ROS% improvement across key product portfolios. The project covers the full product value chain, ranging from initial product design, R&D, and engineering to sourcing, production, sales, delivery, and service. To lead this critical transition into tangible results, Academic Work is recruiting a Senior Project Manager who will join the Strategy Office and drive implementation across the business.
In this role, you will take over leadership of an ongoing performance project during December and January through a structured handover. Your primary task is to convert existing improvement plans into an integrated, cross-functional realization plan with confirmed initiative ownership, clear milestones, and validated financial outcomes. You will work at the intersection of technical execution and financial metrics, ensuring that every operational action directly reflects on the P&L while protecting quality, compliance, and customer value. In your daily work, you will collaborate with key cross-functional stakeholders—including R&D, Sourcing, Operations, Supply Chain, Product Management, Finance, and Sales—while reporting directly to the Head of Strategy Office and steering committee executive sponsors.
This is initially a one-year consulting assignment to cover a parental leave, with a possibility of extension.
You are offered
You will have the unique opportunity to lead high-impact strategic initiatives, mentor junior team members, and collaborate with senior global stakeholders.
Work tasks
Complete a structured handover with the current project lead.  
Review the project baseline, root causes, decisions, initiatives, and expected benefits.  
Convert the existing improvement plan into an integrated realisation plan.  
Confirm clear ownership, resources, milestones, and dependencies.  
Drive cross-functional implementation and remove barriers to progress.  
Maintain the connection between technical actions and financial outcomes.  
Track forecast, implemented, and realised benefits together with Finance.  
Keep the Steering Committee informed and escalate decisions when required.  
Protect quality, delivery, compliance, and customer value during implementation.  
Ensure sustainable ownership in the line organisation and capture lessons learned.

We are looking for
Strong experience in performance improvement, turnaround, or transformation projects.
Proven ability to move projects from analysis into implementation and benefit realisation.
Good understanding of P&L, margin, ROS, and product costing.
Experience working across engineering, sourcing, production, and commercial functions.
Structured, persistent, fact-based, and comfortable challenging stakeholders.
Experience from a global industrial organisation is preferred.
Fluent in English.

It is meritorious if you have
Prior experience working in an international or cross-border team environment.

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
Supportive
Goal oriented
Orderly
Stable
Responsible

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.occupation: Family Medicine Specialist Opportunity in Western Norway
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Europe. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
Build your medical career in one of Norway's most beautiful regions
Would you like to work in a modern and well-organised GP practice with experienced colleagues, a manageable patient list, and excellent opportunities for outdoor activities?
On behalf of a municipality in Vestland County, we are recruiting a Family Medicine Specialist for a permanent position in a well-established GP practice in Western Norway.
This is an excellent opportunity for a doctor who wants professional autonomy, a strong clinical environment, and a high quality of life surrounded by fjords, mountains, and stunning nature.
About the position
You will join a modern GP practice with three experienced GPs and one resident doctor. The available patient list currently consists of approximately 800 patients, with the possibility of increasing the list size over time if desired.
The municipality is committed to maintaining a supportive professional environment with skilled colleagues, experienced support staff, and a strong focus on quality of care.
Your responsibilities will include:
Managing your own patient list
Diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up of patients of all ages
Preventive healthcare and chronic disease management
Up to 20% municipal medical duties
Participation in the local emergency care service rotation

Emergency care services
The municipality is part of an established intermunicipal emergency care collaboration serving five municipalities.
The emergency clinic is located next to the local hospital and offers:
Well-organised out-of-hours emergency services
Municipal acute care beds (KAD)
Emergency medical communication services
24/7 support from experienced healthcare personnel
This provides a safe and professionally rewarding environment during emergency shifts.

We offer
Permanent full-time position
A modern and well-established GP practice
Strong professional support and collaboration
Continuing medical education and professional development opportunities
Assistance with relocation and practical arrangements
Free Norwegian language training
Guidance throughout the Norwegian authorisation process
Dedicated support from an experienced recruitment advisor

About the area
The position is located in Vestland County, home to some of Norway's most spectacular landscapes.
The region offers:
World-famous fjords and mountain scenery
Excellent opportunities for hiking, skiing, cycling, climbing, and fishing
Safe and family-friendly communities
Good schools, cultural activities, and sports facilities
Easy access to larger towns and cities in Western Norway
Here, you can enjoy both an exciting medical career and an exceptional work-life balance.

Qualifications
We are looking for candidates who:
Are specialists in family medicine / general practice (GP)
Hold a valid medical licence and specialist recognition from an EU/EEA country
Have good English language skills
Are motivated to learn Norwegian
Have good communication and collaboration skills
Wish to establish a long-term career and life in Norway

Why Norway?
General practitioners play a central role in the Norwegian healthcare system and are responsible for the long-term follow-up of their own patients. Norwegian healthcare is characterised by high professional standards, collaborative working environments, and a high degree of professional autonomy.
Norway also offers excellent opportunities to combine a medical career with a balanced lifestyle, family life, and access to nature.
Interested?
We would be happy to tell you more about the position and life in Norway. Please contact us for a confidential conversation or send us your CV. We look forward to hearing from you!
You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

Are you passionate about developing reliable software and using technology to create solutions that make a meaningful difference?
At Ascom, we develop technology that supports critical communication and workflows. We are now looking for a Software Engineer to join our R&D organization in Gothenburg and contribute to the development and maintenance of Ascom’s products and solutions. 
About the Role 
As a Software Engineer in the Mobility Functionality DECT/WiFi team, you will play a central role in our product development. You will design, develop and maintain software for handsets, infrastructure and personal alarm devices. You will be working closely with colleagues and relevant stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into robust software features.
You will contribute throughout the software development lifecycle, from technical requirements and design through implementation, verification and continuous improvement. The role also includes supporting the resolution of customer issues and improving our products through maintenance and refactoring. You will work in an agile and collaborative R&D environment where software quality, reliability, performance and maintainability are key priorities. 
Your Contributions 
In this role, you will: 

Elaborate, design and implement embedded software solutions with a focus on functionality, reliability and performance.

Develop embedded software for real-time communication devices and infrastructure products.

Design and implement low-level drivers and hardware near functionality.

Work with real-time operating systems and multitasking/inter-process communication.

Develop network communication stacks.

Contribute to radio communication features and protocols.

Collaborate with hardware, quality and cross-functional stakeholders

Participate in system architecture and technical design decisions, including investigating and proposing solutions.

Understand customer and stakeholder requirements and translate them into software features.

Create technical requirements and design documentation and contribute to user documentation.

Collaborate with colleagues to improve technology, development practices and ways of working.

Support the investigation and resolution of customer-related software issues.

Follow applicable operational documents, development procedures and agile working methods.

Stay up to date with relevant technologies and technical developments. 

The Ideal Candidate 
We believe you have: 

A bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science or a related field.

Approximately two to five years of experience designing and developing software.

Experience in object-oriented C++ development for embedded systems.

Experience with real-time OS, multitasking, and inter-process communication.

Experience with low-level C/C++ development for drivers and data communication.

Experience with communication and data security protocols.

Excellent English skills (spoken and written)

Fluent in Swedish

The ability to analyze technical challenges, identify root causes and develop practical solutions.

Strong communication and collaboration skills.

A customer-focused mindset and an interest in understanding how technology creates value for users.

A proactive approach to learning and professional development. 

What We Offer You 
At Ascom, you will have the opportunity to:

Develop software that contributes to products and solutions used in critical environments.

Work with experienced colleagues in an international R&D organization.

Contribute to the full software development lifecycle.

Work in a collaborative environment that values knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

Develop your technical and professional capabilities through meaningful assignments and collaboration. 

Join Us and Make an Impact
If you are a collaborative and curious Software Engineer who enjoys solving complex problems and developing high-quality software, we would be happy to hear from you. 
Apply today and join our R&D team in Gothenburg.

Ascom is committed to providing an inclusive workplace where individuals are treated fairly and with respect. We welcome applications from qualified candidates with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.

We are looking for a software developer to join our Home & Pro product development team at Dirac at our office in Copenhagen, Danmark. If you are eager to work with cutting-edge audio technologies and contribute to innovative audio solutions, this role is for you. You will work on the Dirac Live end-user application that helps bring our latest flagship technologies to market, including Dirac Live Active Room Treatment (ART), now available on several leading OEMs.
What Dirac Offers You
At Dirac, we provide a highly entrepreneurial environment where you can be part of a team that is passionate about building a great business and inventing the future of sound. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work in leading-edge technologies that make a real impact on everyday experiences. You’ll be a part of a supportive and collaborative agile development team that values quality and continuous improvement. You’ll join a product area with strong momentum, with Dirac Live expanding across premium home audio categories, from AV receivers and processors to streaming amplifiers and soundbars.
Key responsibilities
As a software developer for Dirac Live, you will join an agile product team of passionate developers and audio enthusiasts. You will contribute to the solution’s end-user application, including design, implementation, testing, and evaluation of the front-end. You will be key in integration, testing, and release. Most of the implementation is in C++ and the application is released for Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android. The team also releases plug-ins for digital audio workstations. This code is written in JUCE and is also part of your responsibilities.
Develop the Dirac Live application for desktop and mobile
Implement new features, as well as testing and maintenance of the existing applications
Implement the user interfaces using Qt QML and JUCE
Configure and evaluate the complete solution using audio equipment in our audio labs
Assist the product manager to refine complex and large work items into smaller, valuable and estimated user stories
Assist with 2nd-line customer support

Who you are
Master of Science in Computer Science, Engineering Physics or a related field
2+ years of industry experience of UI development
Experience building cross-platform applications for desktop and mobile
Programming experience and proficiency in C++
A team-oriented attitude, as well as the ability to work independently
Fluency in both spoken and written English
Valid work permit or citizenship that allows you to work in Denmark

Desired qualifications
Programming experience with Qt QML or similar languages
Strong passion for audio, and experience setting up audio systems for recording and mixing audio
Experience with relevant software engineering tools for CI/CD (Git, CMake, Conan)
Experience with agile development
Experience collaborating on UI/UX and product design
Familiarity with signal processing

About Dirac
Dirac is an audio tech company, known for best-in-class technology and a prestigious customer base that includes many of the world’s most reputable brands. We are passionate about audio and innovation, and our pioneering technology is shaping the future of sound experiences.
We are a global company with headquarters in Uppsala, Sweden, and R&D facilities in Copenhagen, Denmark, and Bangalore, India, with representation in Greater China, Germany, Japan, Korea, and the United States.
Please read more about us at https://www.dirac.com/ and follow us on social media!
Location
The location will be at Dirac’s R&D office in Copenhagen.

Join Our Team as Senior Project Manager in Sweden!

Schneider Electric is driving digital transformation in the IT industry, impacting technology platforms and Data Centre solutions for our customers. We are looking for a Project Manager to join our Secure Power division in Sweden to be based in our Stockholm office, with a hybrid working model.

What drives us at Schneider Electric?  
For us, impact isn’t just a term paraded across posters or social media; it’s encoded into our culture. After all, Schneider makes companies, infrastructure, buildings, homes, data centers, and entire industries more efficient and sustainable. With us, you’ll contribute to tackling the climate crisis head-on, and accelerating the energy transition the planet urgently needs. There’s a reason why we’re consistently ranked among the most sustainable companies in the world. Here, you can pursue your dream career while actively making a long-term, positive impact on the planet.  
With us, you’ll contribute to tackling the climate crisis head-on, and accelerating the energy transition the planet urgently needs. What’s more, we help tens of millions of people in underserved communities gain access to energy and education — so you’re making the world a fairer place, too. You’ll sit among colleagues with vastly different personal and professional backgrounds, all united by a vision of a better world. 

What you’ll do  
Develop project plans and associated documents.
Ensure customer satisfaction and financial performance of your dedicated projects.
Manage relationships with customers as well as third parties.
Handle stakeholder management and work package control.
Oversee duties such as risk management, cost control, and procurement coordination.
Support the project team in managing and completing job processes successfully.
Provide technical guidance during the important installation and commissioning phases.
Validate project statements of work and contract terms.
Develop procedures for FAT, SAT, and site logistics.

Essential for the Role
Degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering; a Business degree is a plus.
Experience in project management within construction or engineering sectors.
Strong ability to build and maintain customer relationships.
Demonstrated commitment to task completion and accountability.
Experience with Data Center projects is advantageous.
Familiarity with construction industry regulations is beneficial.
Willingness to travel within Sweden and internationally.
Fluency in English and Swedish is desired

We are looking for a proactive individual with excellent organizational skills who thrives working in an international project environment and collaborating with our customers! Initiative, responsibility, and a desire to contribute to business success are essential.

So, What’s Next?
Are you already imagining yourself joining our team? Great — we can’t wait to hear from you. Apply today and help us shape the future of energy management.

TL;DR:
Lovable's mobile app (React Native, iOS/Android, owned by Team Everywhere) mirrors the web app's functionality while adding native login, push notifications, in-app top-ups, and haptics - it's one of the fastest-growing ways builders reach Lovable. The role is a product-minded fullstack engineer to own end-to-end mobile slices: native flows, auth, push, the web-native bridge, and app store ops (TestFlight, Play Console, compliance) across the full stack.
Why Lovable?
Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
What we’re looking for
At least 6 years of relevant experience at high-pace, high-scale companies
Strong fullstack background: deep comfort with TypeScript/React on the frontend and Node.js or similar on the backend
Hands-on experience with React Native in production, including native module integration.
Experience shipping and maintaining apps through the App Store and Google Play, including review/compliance cycles (Sign in with Apple, IAP, Android policy review)
Product instinct: you think in user outcomes, not just API endpoints
Comfort working with third-party services and building clean abstractions over vendor APIs. Familiarity with managed cloud services (AWS, GCP) and the tradeoffs of buy-vs-build
Experience with push notification infrastructure or native device integrations is a strong plus
You've shipped features in fast-moving, high-ownership environments where you wore multiple hats

What you’ll do
Build and own native mobile features end-to-end: onboarding, auth, push notifications, in-app purchases/credit top-ups, and share targets
Improve the web-native bridge that connects the in-app WebView experience to native device capabilities (keyboard handling, haptics, camera, file sharing)
Own App Store and Play Store submissions, review compliance, and release tooling (TestFlight, Play Console, Fastlane)
Diagnose and fix native-specific bugs and performance issues (cold start, preview loading, crash handling) across iOS and Android

Our Tech Stack
We're building with tools that both humans and AI love. Lovable software engineers are capable of working across the whole stack. Examples of tech in our stack include:
Mobile: React Native, TypeScript, Swift, Kotlin
Frontend: React and Typescript
Backend: Golang and Rust
Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, Firebase
Data: Clickhouse, Firestore, Spanner, BigQuery
DevOps & Tooling: CI/CD pipelines, OTEL, Kubernetes, Terraform, Fastlane

And always on the lookout for what's next!
About your application
Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.
We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

We believe great companies are built by people who are driven to solve difficult problems.
At Nextory, we're building the future of reading and listening. It's an ambitious goal that demands exceptional execution, relentless curiosity, and a willingness to challenge convention. We set a high bar for ourselves because we believe that's what it takes to create products people love.
If you're motivated by impact, energized by ambitious teammates, and excited by the opportunity to build something category-defining, you'll feel at home here.
Let us tell you about the role 📖
This is an Account Manager role that combines opening new doors with creating relationships that last. You’ll be part of our Commercial Business Development team, where you’ll find and sign new valuable partners, while also developing the collaborations we already have across the Nordics. All with one main goal: bringing new listeners and readers to Nextory.
Your main responsibilities will include:

Identifying high-value prospects, reaching out and booking meetings

Negotiating and signing new partner agreements

Planning and launching the first campaign together with new partners

Continuously booking marketing activities with existing partners to drive conversions

Following up on results and finding new ways to improve each collaboration

Working closely with colleagues in Marketing, Product and Analytics to bring campaigns to life

Your story so far 👀
We believe you’re a relationship builder with a hunter’s instinct. You get energy from meeting new people and turning a good conversation into a signed deal, and you’re just as motivated by what comes after: making the collaboration & results grow. Most of all, you’re curious. You like trying new things, taking initiative, and experimenting, even when not everything works out, because around here, that’s how we learn.

jobs.occupation: Technical Writer to a global company in Ludvika
jobs.description:
About our client
Our client, who is a global and world leading actor within their domain, strongly believe in the long-term sustainability of HVDC (High Voltage Direct Current) technology. This technology facilitates energy transfer with direct current at high voltages, making it suitable for transmitting energy over long distances and connecting electricity networks with minimal losses. In addition to energy transfer, HVDC technology addresses electricity quality issues and contributes to the stabilization of connected power grids. For offshore wind power or long-distance underwater transmissions, direct current is the most realistic energy transmission alternative.
About the role
On behalf of our client, we are looking for an experienced Technical Writer to join their team in Ludvika.
In this role, you will be responsible for creating, structuring, and maintaining technical documentation for complex electrical systems and installations, covering everything from high- and low-voltage systems to control systems, HMI, and related equipment.
You will work closely with system engineers, technical specialists, and project teams to gather, analyze, and transform complex technical information into clear, accurate, and well-structured documentation. The role requires both technical understanding and strong communication skills, as you will play an important part in ensuring that technical information is accessible, consistent, and easy to understand across different engineering projects.
Key responsibilities
Create, structure, and maintain technical documentation for electrical installations, systems, and engineering solutions

Gather and interpret technical information in close collaboration with engineers and technical specialists

Produce user manuals, system descriptions, technical specifications, and other relevant documentation

Review, improve, and standardize existing technical documentation to ensure quality, accuracy, and consistency

Plan and coordinate documentation activities across multiple engineering projects

Contribute to improving documentation processes, templates, and ways of working

Who are you?
We are looking for a structured and communicative person who enjoys combining technical understanding with clear and precise writing. You have a genuine interest in technology and the ability to understand complex technical systems and explain them in a way that is easy for others to understand.
To succeed in this role, you are analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable working independently. You take initiative, manage your own priorities, and enjoy collaborating with engineers and technical specialists across different projects. You also take pride in delivering high-quality documentation and contributing to the development of effective ways of working.
We are looking for someone who has:
At least 5 years of experience in technical writing or technical documentation

A university degree, Bachelor’s or higher, in a relevant technical field

Experience documenting complex technical systems or engineering solutions

Good written and verbal communication skills in English

It is considered an advantage if you also have:
Experience with electrical systems, power systems, HVDC technology, or industrial installations

Good communication skills in Swedish

Practical information
Location: Ludvika, Sweden
Scope: Full-time
Start date: As agreed
Employment type: In this recruitment process, you will initially be employed as a consultant by A-hub and work on assignment at our client. After 12 months, the ambition is for you to transition into direct employment with the client.

We look forward to receiving your application!
A-hub is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse working environment. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability.

By submitting your application for this job, you are consenting to A-hub using your personal information in accordance with our GDPR compliance policy.

The Opportunity
At Hitachi Energy Components in Ludvika, we are continuing to grow and develop our business. As more employees join our organization and new competencies are required, ensuring a structured and effective approach to onboarding, training, and competency development has become increasingly important.
We are now looking for a Training & Development Specialist who will take ownership of our internal training structure and learning processes. This is a newly established role with significant opportunity to influence how onboarding, training, and competency development are managed across our organization.
We are looking for someone who enjoys creating structure, coordinating initiatives, and working with a broad range of stakeholders. You bring experience from an industrial, manufacturing, energy, or other technical environment and are comfortable collaborating with technical experts and operational teams.

How you’ll make an impact
Coordinate onboarding and support the continuous improvement of the new employee experience.
Develop and maintain internal training processes and competency development structures.
Coordinate training programs and collaborate with stakeholders across Sweden and globally to ensure relevant and up-to-date training content.
Create and maintain training materials, presentations, guides, and learning resources.
Support subject matter experts in developing structured and effective training programs.
Manage learning systems, training documentation, records, and competency data.
Track training KPIs, identify improvement opportunities, and support continuous development of learning initiatives.

Your Background
Experience in a coordination-focused role such as project coordination, HR, administration, executive support, competency management, or similar.
Experience from an industrial, manufacturing, energy, or engineering environment, with the ability to understand technical roles, processes, and competency requirements.
Experience supporting, delivering, or coordinating training and development initiatives is highly regarded.
Strong communication and facilitation skills, with the confidence to engage and present across different functions and organizational levels.
A continuous improvement mindset with the ability to identify development opportunities and drive improvements.
Professional communication skills in both Swedish and English.

SEASONAL 6-MONTH EMPLOYMENT 2027
ROOF CLEANING TECHNICIAN
Would you like to become part of a growing company that offers good opportunities for professional development while contributing to the sustainable maintenance and protection of our customers’ homes?
Then send your application today!
Candidate selection takes place on an ongoing basis.
JOB DESCRIPTION
As a member of our team, you will represent the company to our customers while carrying out the work. Most of the work takes place in different areas of Sweden, and you will be working outdoors, on the tiled roofs of residential properties.
Your duties will include cleaning tiled roofs and facades. This is a varied job involving many different activities and procedures. Overnight travel may also be required.
At the beginning of your employment, you will receive relevant training in the use of high-pressure cleaning equipment and in working at heights. Previous experience in these areas is, of course, an additional advantage.
The work takes place in different areas of Sweden, from the west coast to the east coast. This means that, alongside your work, you will have the opportunity to experience different parts of the country and discover Sweden from a different perspective.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
This is a physically demanding job that requires good physical ability and skill in using your body, hands, and various tools.
You will work in a two-person team responsible for roof cleaning. For this reason, we place great importance on your ability to cooperate and communicate effectively, accept and handle feedback, and, above all, be willing to work hard and pull your weight when needed.
If you have a colleague or friend who is also interested in coming to work in Sweden, we would be happy to know. The possibility of starting together can make it much easier to form a team, as two people usually work together in each team. In this way, if you come together, the team can be ready from the beginning.
Roof cleaning can involve unexpected challenges related to the surface, dimensions, and similar issues. We are therefore looking for someone who is solution-oriented, is not afraid to take initiative, and can suggest creative solutions.
Naturally, we also want you to be flexible, learn quickly, and contribute to creating a good atmosphere within your team, as well as during any contact with customers.
REQUIREMENTS FOR THE POSITION
• Good knowledge of English.
• B or BE driving licence.
ADDITIONAL QUALIFICATIONS
• Good knowledge of Greek.
• Experience using high-pressure washing equipment, carpentry, roof installation/construction, or similar work involving machinery.
• Experience in the construction and assembly of scaffolding.
• Experience in cleaning and painting tiled roofs, as well as cleaning and painting facades.
WHAT DOES IT MEAN TO WORK AS A ROOF CLEANING TECHNICIAN AT TAKTEAM?
• A high level of freedom and responsibility in your work.
• Good opportunities for professional development.
• Variety in your daily work, with different types of tasks for our customers.
• Work in different areas of Sweden.
• Accommodation provided for the duration of your employment with us. Team members share the same apartment/accommodation.
• Statutory insurance coverage.
• Good benefits and working conditions.
• Hourly-paid employment.
• Salary is paid on the 25th of each month and covers the work performed during the previous month.
Working in different areas of Sweden is not only a professional opportunity, but also a way to experience the country, visit different places, and gain new experiences.
If you are hardworking, responsible, cooperative, and eager to develop your skills within a growing company, we would be happy to receive your application!

How you’ll make an impact
Own and deliver technical training programs across High Voltage products, especially Live Tank Breakers (LTB), supporting customers and internal personnel.
Develop and maintain training curricula, materials, and learning content to ensure training programs reflect the latest products, practices, certification requirements, and industry standards.
Manage competency development and certification activities (especially SF6), including practical assessments, training records, and compliance with applicable training and certification requirements.
Drive the development of the training center and learning offering, identifying capability gaps and introducing new training methods, digital learning solutions, and development initiatives.
Act as a technical subject matter expert and knowledge ambassador, collaborating with product, engineering, and service teams to promote best practices, operational excellence, and a strong safety culture.

Your Background
Experience working with electrical systems, industrial equipment, transformers, motors, generators, or similar technologies in a service, maintenance, commissioning, installation, field engineering, or technical support role.
Ability to explain technical concepts in a clear and practical way, whether through customer interactions, training sessions, workshops, presentations, or knowledge sharing with colleagues.
A self-driven and proactive mindset, with the confidence to work independently and drive improvements and new initiatives.
Ability to quickly learn new software, proficiency in MS Office Suite, and a valid driver's license (B).
Proficiency in both Swedish & English is necessary, additional languages are beneficial.
